dimensions.evidenceA: Covenant blood, forgiveness, many, and future drinking accompany the cup.
dimensions.evidenceB: Kingdom fulfillment accompanies the first cup; new covenant accompanies the cup after supper.
dimensions.label: Attached words

evidence.observation: As they are eating, Jesus takes bread, gives thanks, breaks and gives it; he then takes the cup, and after a hymn they go to the Mount of Olives.
Luke narrates a cup before bread and another cup after supper.

record.tension: Matthew narrates one cup after bread, while Luke narrates one cup before bread and another after supper.
record.title: How many cup actions are narrated, and where?
